VERSION 3.28.0.164

; PaperHid controls in Settings > Help. Independent of MainView / cursor FIFO.
; Every command and argument is fixed at parse time (paperhid-ui allow-list).
AFFECT /qml/device/view/settings/Help.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0
    IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker 2.0

    TRAVERSE Background#root > ScrollArea#flickable > Item#itemWrapper > ColumnLayout#column
        LOCATE BEFORE ArkControls.Body#supportText
        INSERT {
            ColumnLayout {
                id: paperPointerSettingsRoot
                objectName: "paperpointer-settings-root"
                spacing: ArkControls.Values.spacing.medium
                Layout.fillWidth: true

                property string actionStatus: qsTr("Ready")
                property string statusBuf: ""
                property string pairedSummary: qsTr("Paired devices: (refresh)")
                property string layoutSummary: qsTr("Layout: (refresh)")
                property string pointerSummary: qsTr("Pointer: (refresh)")
                property bool pointerInstalled: false
                property bool uiBusy: false
                property string activeOperation: ""

                function applyStatusJson(text) {
                    var raw = (text || "").trim();
                    if (!raw.length)
                        return;
                    try {
                        var j = JSON.parse(raw);
                        if (!j || j.ok === false) {
                            actionStatus = (j && j.error) ? j.error : qsTr("Status error");
                            return;
                        }
                        var ad = j.adapter || {};
                        var sv = j.services || {};
                        var kb = j.keyboard || {};
                        var lines = [];
                        lines.push(qsTr("BT adapter: %1 powered=%2")
                            .arg(ad.present ? qsTr("yes") : qsTr("no"))
                            .arg(ad.powered ? qsTr("yes") : qsTr("no")));
                        lines.push(qsTr("Services: bt=%1 kb=%2 ptr=%3")
                            .arg(sv.bluetooth || "?")
                            .arg(sv.keyboard || "?")
                            .arg(sv.pointer || "?"));
                        if (kb.saved_mac)
                            lines.push(qsTr("Saved keyboard: %1").arg(kb.saved_mac));
                        else
                            lines.push(qsTr("Saved keyboard: (none)"));
                        if (kb.layout)
                            layoutSummary = qsTr("Layout: %1").arg(kb.layout);
                        else
                            layoutSummary = qsTr("Layout: (stock / unknown)");
                        if (j.last_error)
                            lines.push(qsTr("Last error: %1").arg(j.last_error));
                        actionStatus = lines.join("\n");

                        var paired = j.paired || [];
                        if (!paired.length) {
                            pairedSummary = qsTr("Paired devices: (none)");
                        } else {
                            var pl = [];
                            for (var i = 0; i < paired.length; i++) {
                                var d = paired[i];
                                var extra = "";
                                if (d.connected)
                                    extra += qsTr(" [connected]");
                                if (d.trusted)
                                    extra += qsTr(" [trusted]");
                                pl.push((d.name || "?") + "  " + (d.mac || "") + extra);
                            }
                            pairedSummary = qsTr("Paired devices:\n") + pl.join("\n");
                        }

                        var ptr = j.pointer || {};
                        pointerInstalled = !!ptr.installed;
                        if (!ptr.installed) {
                            pointerSummary = qsTr("Pointer: not installed (keyboard-only OK)");
                        } else {
                            pointerSummary = qsTr("Pointer: svc=%1 cursor=%2 hide_ms=%3 accel=%4 style=%5")
                                .arg(ptr.service || "?")
                                .arg(String(ptr.cursor))
                                .arg(String(ptr.cursor_hide_ms))
                                .arg(String(ptr.accel))
                                .arg(ptr.cursor_style || "?");
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        actionStatus = qsTr("Bad status JSON");
                    }
                }

                function friendlyMutation(text) {
                    var raw = (text || "").trim();
                    if (!raw.length)
                        return qsTr("Done");
                    try {
                        var j = JSON.parse(raw);
                        if (j && j.ok === false)
                            return (j.error || qsTr("Failed"));
                        if (j && j.action)
                            return qsTr("OK: %1").arg(j.action);
                    } catch (e) {
                    }
                    return raw.length > 120 ? raw.substring(0, 120) : raw;
                }

                function beginOperation(id, executor) {
                    if (uiBusy)
                        return false;
                    uiBusy = true;
                    activeOperation = id;
                    statusDebounce.stop();
                    if (!executor.startCommand(100)) {
                        uiBusy = false;
                        activeOperation = "";
                        actionStatus = qsTr("Could not start command");
                        return false;
                    }
                    return true;
                }

                function finishOperation(id, outText, armDebounce) {
                    if (activeOperation !== id)
                        return;
                    uiBusy = false;
                    activeOperation = "";
                    if (outText && outText.length)
                        actionStatus = friendlyMutation(outText);
                    if (armDebounce)
                        statusDebounce.restart();
                }

                function refreshStatus() {
                    if (uiBusy)
                        return;
                    statusBuf = "";
                    actionStatus = qsTr("Refreshing...");
                    beginOperation("status", paperHidStatusCommand);
                }

                function runMutation(id, executor, pendingLabel) {
                    if (uiBusy)
                        return;
                    if (executor.outBuf !== undefined)
                        executor.outBuf = "";
                    actionStatus = pendingLabel;
                    beginOperation(id, executor);
                }

                Timer {
                    id: statusDebounce
                    interval: 1500
                    repeat: false
                    onTriggered: {
                        if (!paperPointerSettingsRoot.uiBusy)
                            paperPointerSettingsRoot.refreshStatus();
                    }
                }

                ArkControls.Body {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                    font.bold: true
                    text: qsTr("PaperHid")
                }

                // --- Status ---
                ArkControls.Body {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                    text: qsTr("Status")
                }

                ArkControls.Body {
                    id: paperPointerStatusText
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                    text: paperPointerSettingsRoot.actionStatus
                }

                ArkControls.Button {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                    text: qsTr("Refresh status")
                    enabled: !paperPointerSettingsRoot.uiBusy
                    onClicked: paperPointerSettingsRoot.refreshStatus()
                }

                // --- Bluetooth ---
                ArkControls.Body {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                    text: qsTr("Bluetooth")
                }

                RowLayout {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    spacing: ArkControls.Values.spacing.medium

                    ArkControls.Button {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                        text: qsTr("BT on")
                        enabled: !paperPointerSettingsRoot.uiBusy
                        onClicked: paperPointerSettingsRoot.runMutation(
                            "bt-on", paperHidBtOn, qsTr("Bluetooth on..."))
                    }

                    ArkControls.Button {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                        text: qsTr("BT off")
                        enabled: !paperPointerSettingsRoot.uiBusy
                        onClicked: paperPointerSettingsRoot.runMutation(
                            "bt-off", paperHidBtOff, qsTr("Bluetooth off..."))
                    }

                    ArkControls.Button {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                        text: qsTr("BT restart")
                        enabled: !paperPointerSettingsRoot.uiBusy
                        onClicked: paperPointerSettingsRoot.runMutation(
                            "bt-restart", paperHidBtRestart, qsTr("Bluetooth restart..."))
                    }
                }

                // --- Paired devices (read-only) ---
                ArkControls.Body {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true

                ArkControls.Body {

                // --- Keyboard ---
                ArkControls.Body {

                RowLayout {

                    ArkControls.Button {

                    ArkControls.Button {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                        text: qsTr("KB disable")
                        enabled: !paperPointerSettingsRoot.uiBusy
                        onClicked: paperPointerSettingsRoot.runMutation(
                            "kb-disable", paperHidKbDisable, qsTr("Keyboard disable..."))
                    }

                    ArkControls.Button {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true

                            "kb-reconnect", paperHidKbReconnect, qsTr("Keyboard reconnect..."))
                    }
                }

                // --- Language layout (libepaper; restarts xochitl) ---
                // Stock button height; narrower fixed width (not row-stretch).
                ArkControls.Body {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                    text: qsTr("Language layout")
                }

                ArkControls.Body {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap

                ArkControls.Body {

                }

                RowLayout {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true

                    ArkControls.Button {

                    ArkControls.Button {

                    ArkControls.Button {

                    ArkControls.Button {
                        Layout.fillWidth: false

                        Layout.maximumWidth: 140

                    Item { Layout.fillWidth: true }
                }

                RowLayout {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true

                    ArkControls.Button {
                        Layout.fillWidth: false
                        Layout.preferredWidth: 120
                        Layout.maximumWidth: 140
                        type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary

                    ArkControls.Button {

                    }

                    Layout.fillWidth: true

                    text: qsTr("Pointer and cursor")
                }

                ArkControls.Body {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap

                    ArkControls.Button {

                        type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary

                }

                RowLayout {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    spacing: ArkControls.Values.spacing.medium
                    visible: paperPointerSettingsRoot.pointerInstalled

                    ArkControls.Button {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary

                        enabled: !paperPointerSettingsRoot.uiBusy
                        onClicked: paperPointerSettingsRoot.runMutation(

                    ArkControls.Button {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true

                        enabled: !paperPointerSettingsRoot.uiBusy

                            "style-win95", paperHidStyleWin95, qsTr("Applying..."))
                    }

                    ArkControls.Button {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                        text: qsTr("Restart ptr")
                        enabled: !paperPointerSettingsRoot.uiBusy
                        onClicked: paperPointerSettingsRoot.runMutation(
                            "ptr-restart", paperHidPtrRestart, qsTr("Pointer restart..."))
                    }
                }

                XoviMessageBroker {
                    listeningFor: ["paperpointer.settings.ping"]

                    function onSignalReceived(signal, message) {
                        if (signal === "paperpointer.settings.ping")
                            return "paperpointer-settings-qml-3.28.0.164";
                        return "";
                    }
                }

                // --- Executors: fixed command + fixed args; accumulate stdout ---

                AsyncCommandExecutor {
                    id: paperHidStatusCommand
                    command: "/home/root/.paperhid/paperhid-ui"
                    arguments: ["status", "--fast"]

                    onStdOutAvailable: function(output) {
                        paperPointerSettingsRoot.statusBuf += output;
                    }
                    onRunningChanged: {
                        if (running)
                            return;
                        if (paperPointerSettingsRoot.activeOperation !== "status")
                            return;
                        var buf = paperPointerSettingsRoot.statusBuf;
                        paperPointerSettingsRoot.statusBuf = "";
                        paperPointerSettingsRoot.applyStatusJson(buf);
                        paperPointerSettingsRoot.finishOperation("status", "", false);
                    }
                    Component.onCompleted: paperPointerSettingsRoot.refreshStatus()
                }

                AsyncCommandExecutor {
                    id: paperHidBtOn
                    command: "/home/root/.paperhid/paperhid-ui"
                    arguments: ["bluetooth-on"]
                    property string outBuf: ""
                    property bool launched: false
                    property string opId: "bt-on"
                    onStdOutAvailable: function(output) { outBuf += output; }
                    onRunningChanged: {
                        if (running) {
                            launched = true;
                        } else if (launched) {
                            launched = false;
                            paperPointerSettingsRoot.finishOperation(opId, outBuf, true);
                            outBuf = "";
                        }
                    }
                }

                AsyncCommandExecutor {
                    id: paperHidBtOff

                AsyncCommandExecutor {

                AsyncCommandExecutor {

                    arguments: ["set-cursor-style", "cross"]
                    property string outBuf: ""
                    property bool launched: false

                    onStdOutAvailable: function(output) { outBuf += output; }
                    onRunningChanged: {

                            launched = true;
                        } else if (launched) {
                            launched = false;

                AsyncCommandExecutor {
                    id: paperHidPtrRestart
                    command: "/home/root/.paperhid/paperhid-ui"
                    arguments: ["pointer-restart"]
                    property string outBuf: ""
                    property bool launched: false
                    property string opId: "ptr-restart"
                    onStdOutAvailable: function(output) { outBuf += output; }
                    onRunningChanged: {
                        if (running) {
                            launched = true;
                        } else if (launched) {
                            launched = false;
                            paperPointerSettingsRoot.finishOperation(opId, outBuf, true);
                            outBuf = "";
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
